Third-party software in the Skillroy Test (Java) command line distribution
============================================================================

The project's own code in this distribution (bin/skillroy and the lib/skillroy-*.jar files) is licensed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0; see LICENSE and NOTICE at the top level of this distribution.

The jars below are third-party software. They are in lib/, they are copied here unmodified, and each carries the
licence and attribution files its authors ship inside the jar (META-INF/LICENSE, META-INF/NOTICE and the others
named in the tables below), where it ships any. Please keep the jars as they are: do not repack, shade or minimise
them.

Redistributed artifacts
-----------------------

Each line is: Maven coordinates (group:artifact:version), SPDX licence identifier, file in this distribution.
The line format is read by a test; see "Keeping this file correct" below.

Licences
--------

The Apache-2.0 text is the file LICENSE at the top level of this distribution; it applies to every artifact listed
above as Apache-2.0 whose jar carries no licence file of its own. The MIT and MIT-0 texts, each with the copyright
line of the project it covers, are at the end of this file ("Licence texts"). The licence of each artifact is the one
its Maven POM states (or its parent POM's, for the Jackson datatype modules, the victools modules, swagger-annotations
and SLF4J).

Attributions
------------

Jackson (the com.fasterxml.jackson jars): Copyright 2007-, Tatu Saloranta; developed by a community of developers.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See META-INF/NOTICE and META-INF/LICENSE inside each jar.

SnakeYAML: YAML 1.1 parser and emitter for Java, https://bitbucket.org/snakeyaml/snakeyaml. Licensed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0. The jar contains no licence file of its own; its manifest (Bundle-License) and its
embedded POM name that licence. The licence text is the LICENSE file at the top level of this distribution.

Anthropic Java SDK (anthropic-java, anthropic-java-client-okhttp, anthropic-java-core): Copyright 2023 Anthropic,
PBC. https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-java. Licensed under the MIT License (the POM of each artifact). The
jars carry no licence file; the MIT text with this copyright line is below.

MCP Java SDK (mcp-core, mcp-json-jackson2): Copyright (c) 2025 the original author or authors.
https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk. Licensed under the MIT License (each POM; each manifest's
Bundle-License). The jars carry no licence file; the MIT text with this copyright line is below.

Standard Webhooks Java library (standardwebhooks): Copyright (c) 2023 Svix (https://www.svix.com).
https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks (libraries/java). Licensed under the MIT License (its POM; the
libraries' LICENSE). The jar carries no licence file; the MIT text with this copyright line is below.

SLF4J (slf4j-api, slf4j-nop): Copyright (c) 2004-2022 QOS.ch Sarl (Switzerland). https://www.slf4j.org. Licensed
under the MIT License; the text is META-INF/LICENSE.txt inside each jar, and is repeated below.

Reactive Streams (reactive-streams): Copyright 2014 Reactive Streams. https://www.reactive-streams.org. Licensed under
MIT No Attribution (MIT-0; its POM). The jar carries no licence file; the text is below.

JSqlParser (jsqlparser): https://github.com/JSQLParser/JSqlParser. Dual-licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public
License 2.1 or the Apache License, Version 2.0 (two licence entries in its POM; its manifest's Bundle-License names
both). This distribution takes it under the Apache License, Version 2.0, as the line above says. The jar carries no
licence file; the Apache-2.0 text is the LICENSE file at the top level.

Apache-2.0 artifacts whose jars carry no licence file of their own (their POMs state the licence; the text is the
LICENSE file at the top level): Kotlin's standard library and reflection (kotlin-stdlib, kotlin-stdlib-common,
kotlin-stdlib-jdk7, kotlin-stdlib-jdk8, kotlin-reflect) and JetBrains annotations (annotations), by JetBrains;
OkHttp and Okio (okhttp, okio, okio-jvm), by Square; Project Reactor (reactor-core); the victools JSON schema
generator and its modules (jsonschema-generator, jsonschema-module-jackson, jsonschema-module-swagger-2); the
networknt JSON schema validator (json-schema-validator); ethlo ITU (itu); Error Prone annotations
(error_prone_annotations). The others named Apache-2.0 above (classmate, the Jackson modules, swagger-annotations)
carry META-INF/LICENSE and META-INF/NOTICE inside their jars.

Components embedded in jackson-core
-----------------------------------

The jackson-core jar contains code from the following projects, each under its own permissive licence. The
licence texts are the files named below, inside the jar; they must stay with it.

Each line is: component, SPDX licence identifier, file inside lib/jackson-core-2.22.3.jar.

  FastDoubleParser (shaded copy, by Werner Randelshofer)       MIT           META-INF/FastDoubleParser-LICENSE
  Schubfach number writing code (by Raffaello Giulietti)       MIT           META-INF/Schubfach-LICENSE
  fast_double_parser (by Daniel Lemire, in FastDoubleParser)   BSL-1.0       META-INF/FastDoubleParser-ThirdParty-LICENSE
  fast_float (in FastDoubleParser)                             MIT           META-INF/FastDoubleParser-ThirdParty-LICENSE
  bigint (by Tim Buktu, in FastDoubleParser)                   BSD-2-Clause  META-INF/FastDoubleParser-ThirdParty-LICENSE

Other licence and notice files inside the jars
----------------------------------------------

Each line is: Maven coordinates, file inside that jar. They must stay with their jars.

  org.slf4j:slf4j-api:2.0.16                  META-INF/LICENSE.txt
  org.slf4j:slf4j-nop:2.0.16                  META-INF/LICENSE.txt
  com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp:4.12.0          okhttp3/internal/publicsuffix/NOTICE

OkHttp's notice: the okhttp jar's data file okhttp3/internal/publicsuffix/publicsuffixes.gz is compiled from the
Public Suffix List (https://publicsuffix.org/list/public_suffix_list.dat) and is subject to the terms of the Mozilla
Public License, version 2.0 (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/). The file is distributed unmodified inside the jar; the
list it is compiled from is available, as its source, at the address above.

Keeping this file correct
-------------------------

A test over the assembled distribution (DistributionNoticesIT in the skillroy-cli module) fails the build when this
file and lib/ disagree: a third-party jar in lib/ that is not listed above (or a listed one that is gone or has
another version), a licence outside the allowed list (Apache-2.0, MIT, MIT-0), a licence that neither its jar nor
this file evidences, a licence or notice file inside a jar that is not named here, or a missing LICENSE, NOTICE or
THIRD-PARTY.txt. A jar that carries no Maven coordinates of its own (pom.properties) is identified by its file name.
Change the dependencies, then update this file and docs/licence-audit.md.
